name: ZCA_ROLLUP_UPDATE
description: This is a temporary dynamic table that is used to assign the source object records to balance the batches to be processed by rollup update job.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the source object. This is a foreign key to LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE column in ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK
columns.description: Primary key attribute value of the source object row.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the update batch.
